scope: Ten ranked publication scopes from the preceding review; source download size, prepared asset size, external distribution locations and GEE presence.
counting: Count distinct data distribution services, not bibliography, paper, DOI, homepage or CDN aliases. Multiple GEE assets are one GEE service, with asset IDs retained separately.
A producer page or request form linking to a repository is a discovery route, not a second verified data host until independent delivery is established.
Store exact-scope, related-version/partial and unverified-edition locations separately. Count older hosts in total locations only, never as exact-scope availability.
Missing GEE evidence means not identified in bounded sources. Google Earth is not Google Earth Engine.
sizes: Report decimal MB/GB. Preserve exact bytes where measured or provided by object metadata, rounded estimates as estimates, and unresolved sizes as null.
Source download measures one chosen original representation of the declared scope, not every duplicate format, decadal split, documentation file or full family.
CRU-TS v4.10 selects exactly ten full-period 1901-2025 .dat.nc.gz files, one per variable. Any failed/missing HEAD prevents an exact total from that capture.

TerraClimate baseline selects 1064 annual files for 14 variables and 76 years. Use the frozen listing; check a file header to assess catalog-unit interpretation before converting its rounded Mbytes sum.
Prepared output totals come from checksum-bound release manifests and include analytical Parquet assets plus separately reported PMTiles. Exclude docs/package ZIP/source-order duplicate copies.
acceptance: One canonical availability block per ranked dataset; JSON/CSV/Markdown views generated from canonical YAML only.
Schema and semantic validation reject inconsistent unknown sizes, duplicate service IDs, rank collisions, GEE IDs counted as external, and mismatched evidence/manifest hashes.
Derived counts distinguish all identified services from matching full-scope services. Preserve version caveats in generated views.
Run focused availability tests, existing discovery/catalog checks and a clean-checkout generator rehearsal. No bulk datasets, live GEE calls, builds, uploads or registry submissions.
